meta.title: Tuturuuu Roadmap: what we're building and shipping
meta.description: What Tuturuuu is building: every product track, milestone and deliverable, with what shipped this week, live from public pull requests and deploy checks.
meta.imageAlt: Tuturuuu Roadmap: what is shipping now

title: What we’re building.
intro: Every product, milestone and deliverable, with what has shipped and what’s next. Statuses come straight from public pull requests and live deploy checks.

shipped.title: Shipped this week
shipped.subtitle: Deliverables merged in the last 7 days. “Live” means the production deploy already contains the change.
shipped.empty: Nothing merged in the last 7 days yet.
shipped.moreHint: Feature pull requests merged this week, straight from GitHub.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.subtitle: Each area’s milestones and deliverables. Tap a milestone to see every item.

item.unverified: Merged; the deploy can’t be verified publicly yet
item.notOnWorkers: Merged; app is not served from Workers yet
item.nextRelease: Merged; ships in the next app release

hosting.title: Where each app runs
hosting.subtitle: Each app’s public build-info endpoint, probed from outside Cloudflare, shows which commit it runs and when that commit was made.
hosting.checkedNote: (when this page was built; every deploy checks again)
hosting.notObserved: This build could not check hosting, so every app shows as not verifiable.

migration.title: Moving apps to tuturuuu.com
migration.subtitle: Each app is moving from its own subdomain to a path on tuturuuu.com.
migration.asOf: Checked when this page was built:
migration.method: Moved: the subdomain redirects to its tuturuuu.com path. In progress: the app already answers on its tuturuuu.com path. Not started: neither yet. Unverified: a check got no answer.

method.title: How statuses are computed
method.live: Every pull request is merged and the app’s production deploy is at or after the merge.
method.waiting_for_prod_sync: Merged on main; production doesn’t contain it yet, or the deploy can’t be verified.
method.waiting_for_merge: The pull request is open, ready for review and approved.
method.in_progress: An open pull request, or work we have started without a public PR yet.
method.planned: On the plan. No claims until there is public evidence.
method.sources: Sources: public GitHub pull requests in tutur3u/platform and each app’s public /api/build-info. The page refreshes in your browser every 10 minutes.

footer: Public roadmap. No private operational data. Dates are in Vietnam time (UTC+7).

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Everything that shipped, from the first commit in October 2022 to today. Pick a week, month or year.
timeline.failed: Full history is unavailable right now; showing recent work.
timeline.nothing: No merged changes in this period.
timeline.otherNote: changes across other products, client projects and internal work.
timeline.plannedNote: Work in progress and on the plan, from the tracks below.

pulse.title: Shipping pulse
pulse.source: Last 14 days, from the public pull requests this roadmap tracks.

glance.title: Every product at a glance
glance.subtitle: How much of each track has shipped. Tap a track to jump to its details.
